label: Hike
cue: Hinge back; guide bell between your legs.

label: Drive
cue: Drive through your feet and extend hips.

label: Float
cue: Let the bell float to chest height.

label: Brace
cue: Brace your abs without leaning back.

label: Return
cue: Let the bell fall; keep arms relaxed.

label: Reset
cue: Hinge back as bell passes your legs.
